lines.t: I’ve been running through the silence,
Lost inside my fear again.
Every shadow tried to blind me,
But You called me by my name.
The world was loud, I couldn’t breathe,
But in Your voice, I found my peace.
Now I’m breaking through the chains I made,
And I’m not afraid.
Every scar, You saw beauty in me,
Pulled me out, said, “Come and be free.”
Free in Your light, I’m not hiding anymore,
The weight is gone, I’m Yours forevermore.
No more fear, no more fight,
I’m alive,
Free in Your light.
I’m alive,
Free in Your light.
Used to drown inside my own reflection,
Tried to fight, but I lost direction.
Then You reached into my broken heart,
Turned the ruins into art.
Every fall, You carried me through,
Every breath, I give back to You.
Free in Your light, I’m not hiding anymore,
The weight is gone, I’m Yours forevermore.
No more fear, no more fight,
I’m alive,
Free in Your light.
I’m alive,
Free in Your light.
[Bridge – Both, with violin or synth strings rising]
(Oh-oh) You took the night and painted dawn,
(Oh-oh) Your mercy sings where I belong.
Even when I’m lost, You guide my way,
YahuShua, You are my escape.
Free in Your light, I’m not hiding anymore,
The weight is gone, I’m Yours forevermore.
You broke my chains, gave me life,
Now I rise,
Free in Your light.
Now I rise,
Free in Your light.
